Ava: Heads-up: new joiner hit the Python sample app and got an opaque 'Request failed' error even though API returned 401.
Ravi: That's the py transport swallowing status and rethrowing generic error.
Tess: Node/Go show AuthError with status+code. We should match that.
Noah: Minimal spec idea: exceptions = [AuthError, RateLimitError, ClientError, ServerError, NetworkError]; each has metadata keys: status, code, retryable, retry_after, hint.
Ava: +1. 'hint' should be a short imperative string used by sample apps (e.g. "Run `ri login` to refresh your key.").
Ravi: Implementation note: parse Retry-After header into retry_after; do not convert 4xx -> 5xx. Keep original status.
Tess: Tests: assert status->class mapping, metadata present, retry_after parsed. I'll add parity tests for node/go.
Noah: Also change default exception.__str__ to be user-friendly; include raw body only if RI_SDK_DEBUG=true.
error-bot: created ticket INF-4550: "SDK: unify exception surface + onboarding hints" assigned to ravi.
Ava: Ravi, please drop PR link when ready and we'll run sample-app canary in staging. :thumbsup:
